mapping.root_evidence: size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len); if (size > sizeof(*hdr)) return NULL;
mapping.reason: Step 1 is the admission gate: it checks the REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS flag and dispatches to the proxy parser. Step 4 is the root: it computes the frame size from the attacker-controlled length field and only checks against sizeof(*hdr), which is insufficient for the full frame, enabling buffer overflow. Step 6 is a downstream consumer: it uses the adjusted size and pointer to scan for CRLFCRLF, which can read out of bounds after the overflow.
